integrity: Complete self-contained proof with a standard-library finite checker. The review is same-model only; external independent mathematical verification and exhaustive literature-priority confirmation were not performed.
scientific_limitations: Classical degree-proportional preferential-attachment trees from one initial edge only. The concentration rate is not claimed optimal, the maximizing vertices need not coincide, and the convergence proved is in probability rather than almost surely. The finite checker verifies identities but not the infinite-size assertions.
title: A uniform half-degree law for leaves in preferential-attachment trees
